axis: X transverse, Y up, Z along the bridge
placement: Span centers are 20 m apart. At each internal boundary place one Pier and one Joint at the same track datum. Use North/South abutment scenes at the endpoints. Do not scale to fit a different span length.

extras.reconstructionScope: Independent intact bridge candidate. Its 280 m length follows the present-day crossing/floodplain scale, not a proven 1938 bridge length. Fourteen 20 m spans, all member sections, the transverse timber deck and support layout, pier dimensions, deck elevation, damp staining, weathering and colors are authored design; none establishes the appearance or water level in March 1938. The 44 m compressed FirstLevel1218 blockout and legacy pontoon bridge are not replaced.
